description: A baby sleeps in a dark carved wooden rocking cradle, wrapped in white linen, in a dim room lit from a window at upper left. On a table at left sit a stack of old leather-bound books, with faint lettering on their spines, and a small black-and-brass globe. Through the window behind, a grey industrial city shows smokestacks, smoke plumes and rows of lit windows in low brick houses. The painting has a plain white border around it, and there is a painted signature in the lower right corner.
reason: The painting sits inside a plain white border rather than filling the image edge to edge. Book spines carry painted lettering, and a signature sits in the lower right corner. The picture shows a sleeping baby in a cradle with books and a globe, with nothing that plainly shows the publication of Frankenstein.
